subject: maths
question: A spherical cannonball with a diameter of 28 cm is melted and recast into a rectangular block. The length and breadth of the block are 44 cm and 14 cm respectively. What is the height of the rectangular block?(Take pi = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of sphere = 28 cm

Radius of sphere = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 cm

Length of block = 44 cm

Breadth of block = 14 cm

π = 22 ÷ 7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × π × r³

Volume of rectangular block = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 ÷ 7 × 14³

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 ÷ 7 × 2744

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 ÷ 3 × 22 × 392

⇒ Volume of sphere = 4 × 8624 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of sphere = 34496 ÷ 3

⇒ Volume of block = 44 × 14 × Height

⇒ Volume of block = 616 × Height

⇒ 616 × Height = 34496 ÷ 3

⇒ Height = 34496 ÷ (3 × 616)

⇒ Height = 34496 ÷ 1848

⇒ Height = 56 ÷ 3

⇒ Height = 18.67 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18.67 cm.**
